answer.title: Answer-first summary
answer.body_html: Under AED 2M, the best Dubai off-plan options are usually studios, 1-bedroom apartments, selected compact 2-bedroom units, or payment-plan projects in districts with strong rental, lifestyle or growth logic. The best choice depends on buyer goal, district maturity, developer, handover, payment plan and current availability.
answer.body_text: Under AED 2M, the best Dubai off-plan options are usually studios, 1-bedroom apartments, selected compact 2-bedroom units, or payment-plan projects in districts with strong rental, lifestyle or growth logic.

risk_notes.title: Risk notes
risk_notes.body: For under-AED-2M off-plan projects, the main risks are weak floor plans, remote district positioning, unclear service charges, aggressive payment plans, handover delays, limited resale liquidity and buying only because the entry price looks attractive.

items.question: Can I buy an off-plan property in Dubai under AED 2M?
items.answer: Yes. Under AED 2M, buyers usually look at studios, 1-bedroom apartments, selected compact 2-bedroom options in emerging districts, or payment-plan projects outside ultra-prime areas.

items.question: Which Dubai areas are usually relevant under AED 2M?
items.answer: Relevant areas can include JVC, selected Dubai Hills apartments, Business Bay compact units, Dubai Creek Harbour selected options, Arjan, Meydan and emerging communities depending on availability.

items.question: What should I check before choosing?
items.answer: Check developer, payment plan, handover, service charges, floor plan, district maturity, rental logic, escrow/project status and current availability.
